findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/merge-authorize.ts::two concurrent faff merge authorize runs can both declare the same effect
findings.title: Two concurrent faff merge authorize runs can both declare the same effect
findings.action: Accept: a duplicate declare is harmless
findings.disposition_rationale: A duplicate declare grants nothing and every coverage reader accepts any covering declare; grants stay idempotent on the signed verdict's inputs. merge-gate's own autoDeclareMergeEffects uses the same read-then-append top-up without a lock.

occurrences.title: Two concurrent faff merge authorize runs can both declare the same effect

findings.title: A deny leaves a declared effect with no grant, by design but undocumented
findings.action: Document that a deny leaves the declaration
findings.disposition_rationale: The faff merge authorize row now states a deny leaves the declaration in place with no grant, so merge-gate still refuses (319e6a6d).

occurrences.title: A deny leaves a declared effect with no grant, by design but undocumented
